description: Simulation of concrete dataset mixture candidates built in data/dataset_mixture_candidates_v0_1.

4b.description: Mid-small dense profile: stronger than 2B but still sensitive to damaged quantization.

9b.description: Larger 9B profile: stronger base signal, lower quantization-like noise, less cascade.

27b.description: Large dense profile: stronger classifier/activation signal and meaningfully reduced cascade.

35b_a3b_moe.description: MoE profile with 35B total / ~A3B active behavior: resilient routing and lower cascade under compression, but not as dense-active as a full 35B.

candidates.name: routed_tri_structural_65
candidates.description: Primary routed candidate: structural primitives carry most signal, cognitive gives broad transfer, cyber keeps source boundaries.

candidates.name: routed_tri_structural_60
candidates.description: Slightly broader routed candidate with more cognitive transfer while keeping structural as the control substrate.

candidates.name: cognitive_structural_25_75
candidates.description: Cleaner non-cyber candidate for general small-model capability improvement.

candidates.name: cyber_structural_25_75
candidates.description: Source-boundary candidate for prompt-injection and authority-separation behavior.

candidates.name: q2_structural_amplifier
candidates.description: Stress candidate for badly damaged Q2: heavier repeated structural signal with explicit clean-stop restraints.

candidates.name: stability_first_tri_70
candidates.description: Conservative candidate: maximizes gate, carrier, checksum, and clean-stop behavior over breadth.
